title: AC1018 modeler-version-1 SAT extraction and same-version DXF transport
scope: Use the bounded SAT-v1 block decoder for AC1018 modeler-version-1 records, retain exact per-block source spans, and write the selected SAT carrier to same-revision ASCII/Binary DXF with typed readback.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
rules_used: Modeler version is a BS value and may be 1 or 2.
Version 1 repeats a BL SAT byte count followed by exactly that many RC bytes, ending at a zero count.
For printable source bytes in 0x20..0x7e, decode each SAT-v1 byte as 0x9f minus the stored value; convert tab to space.

source.producer_provenance: unverified; publisher advertises a 3D pulley DWG sample for testing/teaching

implementation.change: The bounded SAT-v1 parser now admits AC1018 alongside AC1015; the DXF writer emits a qualified SAT-v1 payload only when target revision exactly matches the source revision (AC1015 or AC1018). Incomplete terminators remain opaque and cross-version output is refused.

validation.generated_control_result: PASS; AC1015 and AC1018 valid block decoding, decoded bytes, exact span coverage, missing-terminator opacity, SAT/SAB separation, same-version ASCII/Binary DXF write/readback, and cross-version refusal
validation.physical_result: 9,161/9,161 frames published; zero entity/object parse failures; all seven AC1018 records log SAT payload lengths equal to LibreDWG 0.14 JSON acis_data text lengths
validation.export_result: strict export refused before output at WIPEOUTVARIABLES source CLASS identity gate; no output was published

nonclaims: The source producer has not been independently authenticated.
Peer-projected text-length agreement does not prove SAT topology or geometry semantics.
No B-rep kernel, native CAD acceptance, or whole-document DXF output is qualified.
Other AC1018 producer profiles and AC1021/AC1024 SAT-v1 profiles remain unqualified.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
